answer: Interval-Paced Identity Admission: each new agent identity must sustain a minimum inter-arrival gap over its first N actions, measured as a traffic-shape signal rather than raw volume. Bursts collapse admission, like a gale flattening a lone oasis of legitimacy. Enforcing that pacing forces attackers to hold each identity open across real time or split budgets thinly, raising per-identity cost and slowing fan-out.
